# Main firmware component.
#
# kws_ops.inc is generated by `make frontend` (edge/tools/export_frontend_header.py)
# and must exist before the first build; the Makefile target `esp32-build` takes
# care of ordering.  If it is missing, the build stops with a pointer to the
# command that produces it, rather than with a confusing C++ error.

if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/kws_ops.inc")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "edge/esp32/main/kws_ops.inc is missing.\n"
        "Generate it from a trained run first:\n"
        "    python -m ml.tools.export_tflite --run-name <run>\n"
        "    python -m edge.tools.export_frontend_header --run-name <run>")
endif()

if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/model_int8_tflite.h")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "edge/esp32/main/model_int8_tflite.h is missing.\n"
        "It is written by ml/tools/export_tflite.py (the model as a C array).")
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "kws_app.c" "kws_uplink.c" "bench_task.c" "kws_runner.cc"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES driver esp_wifi esp_http_client nvs_flash esp-tflite-micro
)

# C++17 for the TFLite-Micro API.
target_compile_features(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC cxx_std_17)

# The front-end is timing-critical on the audio path: optimise it even in a
# debug build, otherwise benchmarking -O0 numbers is meaningless.
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -O2)
